review.finding: _each_end folds only to the title line; a Prettier-wrapped `{ tag: [...] }` on the following line is not joined, so a natively tagged it.each test is enumerated untagged -> false untagged-added STOP and missing RTM link.
review.suggestion: After locating the title, continue folding to the callback line (reuse _head_end from the title line); add a tagged next-line-title test. FIXED: _each_end now continues to the callback line; test_a_tag_on_the_line_after_a_next_line_title_still_binds.

review.finding: Decorators enter the anonymised digest but parametrize argnames are string constants, so a consistent rename of a parametrized argument is no longer mechanically_renamed.
review.suggestion: Treat parametrize argname strings as bindings in anonymise mode. FIXED: _Bindings.visit_Call masks bound argnames.

review.finding: After rejecting a run-on .each candidate the scan skips the rest of the line, so a second .each test on that line is never located.
review.suggestion: Resume at the callee start + 1. FIXED: _decls retries on the same line.

review.finding: Lazy table scan runs per .each line per title search; quadratic on files with hundreds of .each tests (unmeasured).
review.suggestion: Index declarations once per file text. DISCLOSED in the iterate spec Out of Scope.
